waybettercoppergolem.guide.title: Copper Golem Sorting
waybettercoppergolem.guide.page.1:
§lCopper Golem Sorting§r

Golems take items from §ocopper chests§r and deliver each to the chest §olabeled§r for it.

A label is an item, a tag (Ingots), a category (Food), catch-all, or off-limits.
waybettercoppergolem.guide.page.2:
§lZones§r

Sneak-right-click a copper chest with an empty hand: that's its zone — a box and a few settings.

Golems only take and deliver inside the box. Set the box with §oSet area§r and two clicks of the %s.
waybettercoppergolem.guide.page.3:
§lLearn§r

In the zone screen press §oLearn this zone's chests§r. Every chest gets a label proposed from what it holds.

Read the preview in chat, click §a[Apply]§r. Repeat any time; it only touches unlabeled chests.
waybettercoppergolem.guide.page.4:
§lThe %s§r

Sneak-left-click a chest: copy its labels.
Sneak-right-click a chest: paste them.
Sneak-right-click the air: pick any label.

Hold it to see labels and zones on the HUD.
waybettercoppergolem.guide.page.5:
§lGolem button§r

Open any chest and press §oGolem§r beside it to edit that chest's labels, with suggestions from what's inside.

On a copper chest it opens the zone.
waybettercoppergolem.guide.page.6:
§lFrames§r

An item frame on a chest gives it an §oauto§r label: the framed item, broadened by what's inside.

Labels you set yourself always win. Frames are never clicked by the mod.
waybettercoppergolem.guide.page.7:
§lWhen things look wrong§r

Zone screen → §oOverview§r lists every chest, problems first.
§oSimulate§r shows where each stack would go right now.

/wbcg zone, /wbcg learn, /wbcg categories.
